title: Find unique zero-sum triples
summary: Return each distinct triple of values whose sum equals zero.
requirements: Return triples [a,b,c] whose sum is 0, with a <= b <= c.
Return each distinct value triple only once, regardless of repeated elements or index combinations.
Do not mutate the input array.
Aim for O(n²) time after sorting.
hints: Sort a copy of the numbers so duplicates are adjacent.
For each anchor index, move left/right pointers based on the three-value sum.
Skip repeated anchor and pointer values to avoid duplicate triples.
